description: List email conversations. awaiting_reply=true returns only the threads where someone has written in and no answer has been sent, which is what needs a response. A reply held for approval or scheduled does not count as sent: such a thread stays in that list with pending_reply true, meaning its answer is already on the way. Most recently active first, at most 100 per call; while has_more is true, next_cursor passed back as cursor with the same awaiting_reply returns the next page.

awaiting_reply.description: true: only threads waiting on an answer. false: only threads that are not. Omitted: all

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged

name: list_threads
